newsitem.title: UK: NORWAY EKOFISK TO LOAD 21 MLN BLS IN SEPT - TRADE.
newsitem.headline: NORWAY EKOFISK TO LOAD 21 MLN BLS IN SEPT - TRADE.

text.p: Norway's Ekofisk crude oil pipeline system should load 21 million barrels in September in 39 cargoes, down from the 21.79 million expected in August, traders said on Wednesday.
The September programme will consist of 15 cargoes of 600,000 barrels and 24 cargoes of 500,000 barrels, they said.
The sources said the programme was in line with expectations and reflected the shorter month. Flow rates are expected to average a steady 700,000 barrels per day.
Ekofisk cargoes load at Teeside in northeast England.
